units.rationale: OperationSpec at regression_operation_adapter.py:2144 maps to _harness_ensure_session_1:2928, which runs controller ensure-session --destination-id with timeout 420 and optional ENCHRON_CONTROLS_AUTO_HIDE_SECONDS in [1,300]. The handler requires stage success via _require_success and returns session plus the applied controlsAutoHideSeconds default 300. Role setup and invalidation tag lane.instance match establishing the exclusive runner; SKILL.md Launch names this command as the session gate on both lanes.

OperationSpec at :2219 takes optional rootFolderName and handler _harness_reset_product_state_2:3346 relaunches, runs resetState, then listLibrary. It compares validate_product_state_reset_receipt against validate_library_snapshot so remainingReferenceCount is 0 and folder names equal the requested root. Feature map README.md states the clean-state order is resetState then relaunch then import; this handler relaunches first then resetState and checks the empty library, so the named fixture key Journey Fixture used by the preparation adapter is reconstructable after retry.

OperationSpec at :2221 plus _host_preflight:406 close check to smb-aggregate, audio-fixtures, emby-aggregate, system-import-fixtures, and REMOTE_PREFLIGHT_CHECKS, with phase ensure|activate|restore. Handler _host_preflight_1:3640 on activate returns receiptID and generationToken from validate_remote_activation_receipt, and restore consumes that receiptID as required by execution-protocol.md host calls. Ensure rejects recipe and receiptID, so the restore ordering cannot skip the receipt binding.

OperationSpec at :2465 is SIMULATOR-only, matching the contract, and _device_hub:1945 requires either system-toolbar plus systemControl=home or the complete shotX/shotY/shotWidth/shotHeight set inside the screenshot. Handler _input_device_hub_pinch_2:6391 runs device_hub_canvas.py pinch or system-control and then snapshots postActionState. SKILL.md and simulator.md name Device Hub gaze-and-pinch as the simulator spatial input route, so the arguments select a current driver without a wearer.

OperationSpec at :2463 is SIMULATOR-only with no arguments. Handler _input_device_hub_prepare_1:6368 runs device_hub_canvas.py enlarge and requires canvas.width >= 1200 before returning the binding. simulator.md requires enlarging Device Hub and switching the canvas to fit before any locate or click; this setup call is that prerequisite and invalidates input.device-hub and lane.instance accordingly.

OperationSpec at :2340 is diagnostic-bypass with category closed to mediaOpeningFailed and playbackControlFailed. Handler _issue_present_1:5084 runs app-command showPlaybackIssue and records category plus the command response. execution-protocol.md says diagnostic-bypass must not assign product coverage; empty evidenceSchemas match that, and the injected issue surface is a current test-channel verb rather than a future route.

OperationSpec at :2355 emits library.command/library-command@1 from _library_snapshot_1:5098, which calls listLibrary and validate_library_snapshot. Cross-validator _library_snapshot:1987 requires LIBRARY_BASELINE_FIELDS as one complete equal-length set or a lone systemImportExpectation in {files, photos}, and result:// entries must select /referenceID, /folderID, /sourceIdentity, /sourcePath, /sourceDigest, or /fileName. Those result fields are exactly what media.import-staged@2 returns, so later snapshots can bind without inventing keys.

OperationSpec at :2306 takes fileName, emits library.command/library-command@1, and _direct_filename:1762 requires a single basename. Handler _media_import_staged_2:4885 calls importMedia file= then listLibrary, requiring exactly one new file-backed reference whose name equals fileName, and returns referenceID, folderID, sourceIdentity, sourcePath, sourceDigest, and fileName. Feature map README.md names Documents/TestMediaInbox/ plus importMedia as the injected ingest that still joins the production pipeline, so the product-behavior role records library state rather than the command return alone.

OperationSpec at :2319 plus _media_open:1800 accept only playback-start identifiers MediaLibrary-grid-video-*, FileBrowsing-grid-video-*, Emby-Episode-*, Emby-Detail-Resume, and Emby-Detail-PlayFromBeginning. Handler _media_open_2:5039 taps that identifier, then either _wait_for_window on expectedLanding or _wait_for_expected_issue, and sets succeeded only when surface-probe lines contain openRequestForwarded. deadlineSeconds is the named wait bound; deliveryObserved prevents treating tap returnCode as open proof.

OperationSpec at :2305 requires fixtureID and absolute sourceRoot via _stage_fixture:1742. Handler _media_stage_fixture_2:4861 loads Tests/Fixtures/fixture-registry.json through stage_registered_fixture and copies into the lease-bound container via _LeaseBoundFixtureTransport, including xcrun devicectl copy for the device lane. Role setup and invalidation tag fixture.corpus match staging only; the returned receipt is the reconstructable identity for later import-staged calls.

OperationSpec at :2188 closes tab to files, settings, emby, environment. Handler _navigation_select_tab_1:3111 taps Navigation-Ornament-tab-files, Navigation-Ornament-tab-settings, Emby-Navigation-Tab, or Navigation-Ornament-tab-environment and requires the matching destination identifier FileBrowsing-FilesScreen, Settings-SettingsScreen, Emby-Root, or EnvironmentCard-card in postActionState hierarchy. That is the product public tab route, and invalidation tags ui.navigation and ui.state match the ornament change.

OperationSpec at :2404 requires presentation in {window, portal, either-main-window}, lifecycle in {playing, ready, paused, ended, any-steady}, controls in {shown, hidden, either}, and deadlineSeconds in [1,90]. Handler _playback_await_window_state_1:5464 polls _wait_for_window:2726 against PlayerUI-window-control-plane until those named predicates hold. Empty invalidation tags are correct because this wait does not drive product state; succeeded follows the diagnostic string, not the last snapshot returnCode.
